checks.name: Repeated exact full inputs reuse actual results including unsafe contacts
Consumers cannot mutate either stored results or later returned clones
Signed zero is lossless, and property/array order and missing arguments remain distinct
Nonfinite, functions, cycles and nonplain inputs bypass without changing original validation
Key construction never invokes accessors before the original implementation does
Hidden, symbol and custom-array behavior cannot alias ordinary literal inputs
Changing live qpos clears the cache and permanently bypasses the job
Changing live ctrl clears the cache and permanently bypasses the job
Replacing model invalidates the private job epoch
Replacing data invalidates the private job epoch
Replacing map invalidates the private job epoch
Replacing robotBodyIds invalidates the private job epoch
Replacing footBodyIds invalidates the private job epoch
Replacing floorGeom invalidates the private job epoch
Bounded LRU entries retain hot checks and evict old results without changing them
The byte bound evicts results, and oversized diagnostics are not retained
Unsupported return values bypass storage and preserve the original value
A cancelled or failed job restores the exact original method and frees all entries
Bounds reject invalid configuration before changing the original method
